description: Cocos Island Building Outlines 2013 is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. Lineage: Digitisation was done from scratch off the 2011 orthophotography within Quantum GIS. Using the ArcMap 'zonal statistics' tool the minimum, mean and maximum heights were found for each building polygon from the 2011 digital elevation model and the 2011 digital surface model (DSM). This information was then joined to the building polygon attribute table. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. Its tags are Cocos Keelling Islands, IOT, building, infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2025-11-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
